messages.subject: Project Ironvale - COMPLETED
messages.plaintextBody:
All,

I'm pleased to confirm that Project Ironvale completed today, Friday 12 December 2025. Crestview Ironvale Bidco Limited now owns 100% of Stradbrook Thermal Limited. Cash of £39.2m has been paid to the Sellers' Solicitors and £2.0m is held in escrow for 18 months. The executed SPA and the final completion checklist are attached for the file.

Thank you all for a smooth process. Post-completion filings and the completion-accounts timetable to follow.

James

Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
